lines: You wake up with a new haircut. The Sindaco was passing with his scissors and couldn't help himself.
Somebody has trimmed your fringe in the night. A comb lies on the bench, and the Sindaco is whistling across the square.
Your hair is shorter on one side. On the other side, a note: 'Back after the bells. G.'
A cat has slept on your chest all night, and it has no plans to move.
You wake under a warm weight: a cat, purring, settled in for the morning.
Three cats share the bench with you. You have the smallest part of it.
You wake just in time to see a gull fly off with the farinata you'd saved for breakfast.
A gull is standing on your knee, eating your breakfast. It looks at you as if you're the one in the way.
Something tugs at your bag: a gull, leaving with the last of your farinata.

done: {title}: done, says Nonna Gina; Nonna Delia says 'it could have gone worse'
{title} finished. Gina told everyone at the wash-house before it was
The Geometra finishes {title}. Delia checked the corners twice
built: {n} new pieces yesterday, counts Gina; Delia counted one fewer
The Geometra put up {n} pieces. The cats have already tried all of them
{n} new pieces in Liolivato. The Sandals photographed every one
opened: The Sindaco opened {what} {place}, in his best cap
{What} {place}: the Sindaco cut the ribbon, then gave the ribbon a trim
Ribbon cut on {what} {place}. The bells rang, a little late
quiet: Nothing built yesterday. Gina had to talk about the weather
Quiet day. Delia says that's how she likes them
Slow news at the wash-house: a cat sat in a basin
paper.verdict: Nonna Delia's verdict on the new build: {grade}.
paper.regrown: Overnight the chestnuts, the broom and the rubble came back.

inauguration.speaker: olive_village_giobatta
open: Liolivato! Tonight I give you {what} {place}. Hats off. Not mine, I have four.
Citizens, all thirty-eight of you: behold {what} {place}.
Gather round {what} {place}, and mind the cats.

need: For years you told me: “{noticed}” Well, here it is.
“{noticed}” Not any more. Your Sindaco listens.
own: Right outside my barber shop. Very convenient.
Where I can see it from my chair, between customers.
art: It has a certain... look. The Sandals will photograph it.
Bold. Very bold. I approve, as your Sindaco.
tall: Tall! You can see it from the bell tower.
Taller than my ladder, and I have a long ladder.
colour: What colours. The nonnas are speechless, which never happens.
Such colour. I'll wear my brightest cap to match.
many: {n} pieces in a day. The Geometra doesn't sleep. On a bed, at least.
plain: It stands. In Liolivato, that's a good start.

close: I'll put it on the sign. Not the number, the number's for people. Scissors!
My idea, of course. The Geometra held the ladder.
Remember this at the next election. Not that anyone else stands.
